changelog: Fixes pinclock-early-splash.service failing outright (Unable to locate executable) and the existing swaybg splash silently showing a stale, out-of-date image - both traced to /home/vfw/pinclock, a compatibility symlink that run_update.py's OTA symlink swap never actually maintains (it only ever repoints /opt/pinclock/current). On any device that's been through even one firmware update since initial imaging, that symlink can silently drift out of sync with what's actually running. Both the early-splash unit and the swaybg fallback now reference /opt/pinclock/current directly, matching pinclock.service's own existing convention. NOTE: home-vfw-config-labwc/autostart still has two other references to the same stale symlink (network_boot.sh and gen_playlist.py) that were not changed here - worth checking/fixing separately. Requires re-running deploy_manual_files.sh to pick up the corrected unit file and autostart.
